question.scenario: Your security team needs custom dashboards to visualize security data: identity risks, network threats, and compliance status.
question.question-text: How should you create security visualizations?

choices.choice: Default portal views only
Export data to Excel for manual charting
Third-party BI tools exclusively
Azure Workbooks with KQL queries against Sentinel and Defender data

hint.label: Brief Hint
hint.content: Which Azure visualization tool lets you build interactive, KQL-driven dashboards from Log Analytics and security data?

hint.label: Complete Explanation
hint.content: Azure Workbooks provide interactive reports and dashboards using KQL queries. Query data from Log Analytics, Sentinel, and Defender for Cloud. Combine visualizations (charts, grids, maps), parameters for filtering, and drill-down capabilities. Share workbooks across the team or organization.

ul.li: Sentinel content hub includes pre-built workbooks for many data sources.
Parameters enable interactive filtering without editing queries.
Groups organize visualizations with tabs or accordions.
Export to PDF or share via workbook templates.
